value: Prophet David, the ancestor of God, spoke of thee in psalmody unto Him Who hath accomplished great things in thee. For God was well pleased without father to become a man from thee, the Queen who standeth at His right hand, and He - the source of life - showed thee to be His mother, that He might renew His own image, corrupted by the passions. Having found the lost sheep wandering on the mountain He hath laid it upon his shoulders, that He may bring it to his Father; and in accordance with His own will unite it to the heavenly Powers and thus, O Theotokos, save the world, Christ, Who is richly and abundantly merciful.
